messages:
Sam (Finance): quick question — we invoiced a customer for a 3-month prepaid committed pool + monthly usage. do we defer the whole prepay and amortize, or do we split recognition differently because the customer can draw credits? need suggested journals for close today.
Ben (Accounting): Defer the prepay on invoice date, then recognize ratably over the service period unless contract says otherwise. usage is recognized when earned. if unused credits are forfeited at term end that's breakage — estimate and recognize per GAAP. suggested entry examples below.
Priya (RevOps): can you paste the invoice lines & contract term? also need to know if credits rollover or are refundable.
Sam (Finance): invoice excerpt: ```Invoice: 2026-045
Line 1: Committed Dedicated Pool - 3mo prepaid Apr1-Jun30 - $150,000
Line 2: Monthly usage (Mar invoice) - $3,200
Contract: credits expire at term end, non-refundable; renewal option subject to amendment.```
Liam (Sales): fwiw sales docs mentioned a renewal conversation but no automatic rollover. we may have a verbal promise, i'll check amendments. :eyes:
Ben (Accounting): sample journals: 
- On invoice (Apr 1): Dr Cash 150,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 150,000
- Monthly recognition (Apr/May/Jun): Dr Deferred Revenue 50,000 / Cr Revenue 50,000
- Usage billed when earned: Dr AR 3,200 / Cr Revenue 3,200
If breakage is material and we can estimate, record a contra deferral release using historical breakage %. If immaterial, recognize when forfeited.
Priya (RevOps): for the deferral schedule, what GL codes should we use? accounting needs codes for the journal request form.
Ben (Accounting): use Deferred Rev GL 2305, Revenue GL 4001, Cash 1002, AR 1101. put memo: "Prepaid committed pool - Apr-Jun 2026".
rev-ops-bot: Automated deferral schedule created: DEF-8342 linked to Invoice 2026-045, frequency: monthly Apr/May/Jun.
Sam (Finance): perfect — thanks. Ben, can you post the exact journal lines in the request system? i'll attach contract and send to Ops. :thumbsup:
Ben (Accounting): will do in ~30m. tagging Priya for approval of breakage policy if we need to estimate.
Priya (RevOps): approving use of historical breakage for estimate if no amendment found. pls include backup.
Sam (Finance): noted — i'll upload contract & invoice to the request. closing this thread once journals queued. thanks everyone!
